
===== applyDungeon21MobStats =====

function applyDungeon21MobStats(e,si){
  if(DUNGEON_MODE!=='21+'||!e||e.isBoss)return e;
  const p=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[si]||null;
  const room=p?Number(p[2]||0):0;
  // Keep the old 1–20 sprite identity, but DISPLAY the 21+ dungeon as levels 21–40.
  const baseLvl=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,Number(e.lvl)||1));
  e.baseLvl=baseLvl;
  e.lvl=baseLvl+20;

  // V216: cycle archetypes INSIDE each room so ЖИВУЧИЙ / БРОНИРОВАННЫЙ /
  // БЕРСЕРК обязательно встречаются в каждой нормальной пачке.
  let roomOrd=0;
  for(let j=0;j<(Number(si)||0);j++){
    const pj=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[j];
    if(pj&&Number(pj[2]||0)===room)roomOrd++;
  }
  const v=DUNGEON21_ARCHETYPES[roomOrd%DUNGEON21_ARCHETYPES.length];
  const originalName=(e.type&&e.type.n)||'МОБ';
  e.type=Object.assign({},e.type||{}, {n:v.label+' · '+originalName});

  // V173 progression: post-30 mobs start above 2,000 HP so +5/+7 gear has real content to fight.
  var minHp,maxHp,t;
  if(e.lvl<=25){minHp=900;maxHp=1300;t=(e.lvl-21)/4;}
  else if(e.lvl<=30){minHp=1300;maxHp=1800;t=(e.lvl-26)/4;}
  else if(e.lvl<=35){minHp=2000;maxHp=3000;t=(e.lvl-31)/4;}
  else if(e.lvl<=40){minHp=3000;maxHp=4500;t=(e.lvl-36)/4;}
  else if(e.lvl<=45){minHp=4500;maxHp=6500;t=(e.lvl-41)/4;}
  else {minHp=6500;maxHp=9000;t=Math.min(1,(e.lvl-46)/4);}
  t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
  var hpBase=minHp+(maxHp-minHp)*t;
  var archetypeMul=v.key==='tough'?1.10:(v.key==='berserk'?0.92:1.00);
  e.hp=Math.round(Math.max(minHp,Math.min(maxHp,hpBase*archetypeMul)));
  // V212 flat HP rebalance: +250 for levels 21-30, +210 for levels 31-40.
  var hpBonus=(e.lvl<=30)?250:((e.lvl<=40)?210:0);
  e.hp+=hpBonus;
  e.mhp=e.hp;

  // V216 DEF:
  // - levels 30–40 receive +6 DEF over the previous curve;
  // - БРОНИРОВАННЫЙ has exactly x2 DEF versus the normal archetype.
  var defSteps=Math.max(0,Math.floor((e.lvl-30)/5));
  var baseDef=Math.round(Math.max(20,e.lvl-1)*(1+defSteps*0.05));
  if(e.lvl>=30&&e.lvl<=40)baseDef+=6;
  e.def=(v.key==='armored')?baseDef*2:baseDef;
  e.dmg=v.dmg;

  e.dungeon21=true;e.dungeon21Kind=v.key;e.dungeon21HpBonus=hpBonus;
  // Visuals/sprites stay EXACTLY the same to avoid increasing game weight.
  return e;
}
function applyDungeon41MobStats(e,si){
  if(DUNGEON_MODE!=='41-60'||!e||e.isBoss)return e;
  const p=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[si]||null;
  const room=p?Number(p[2]||0):0;
  const baseLvl=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,Number(e.lvl)||1));

  let roomOrd=0;
  for(let j=0;j<(Number(si)||0);j++){
    const pj=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[j];
    if(pj&&Number(pj[2]||0)===room)roomOrd++;
  }

  const ref=dungeon21ReferenceStats(baseLvl,roomOrd);
  const originalName=(e.type&&e.type.n)||'МОБ';
  e.type=Object.assign({},e.type||{}, {n:ref.v.label+' · '+originalName});

  e.baseLvl=baseLvl;
  e.lvl=baseLvl+40;              // displayed level 41–60
  e.hp=Math.round(ref.hp*3);
  e.mhp=e.hp;
  e.def=Math.round(ref.def*3);
  e.dmg=Math.round(ref.dmg*3);

  e.dungeon41=true;
  e.dungeon41Kind=ref.v.key;
  e.dungeonReferenceLevel=ref.lvl;
  return e;
}

function dungeonDisplayName(){
  if(DUNGEON_MODE==='41-60')return 'ПОДЗЕМЕЛЬЕ 41–60';
  if(DUNGEON_MODE==='21+')return 'ПОДЗЕМЕЛЬЕ 21–40';
  return 'ПОДЗЕМЕЛЬЕ';
}
function dungeonDisplaySub(){
  if(DUNGEON_MODE==='41-60')
    return 'Уровни 41–60';
  if(DUNGEON_MODE==='21+')
    return 'Уровни 21–40 · Владыка Скверны';
  return 'Уровни 1–20 · Зал Феникса';
}
